## Goal

Add the failing unit tests that pin the capacity-template contract (parent AC1–AC6) **before** the `HandView` fix lands, so the regression is captured as an executable specification.

## Context

Parent: CG-0MUAYBB4E007LWEQ. Test-first item.

Today `HandView.computeCardPositions()` builds one row centred on the **current** `cards.length`, and `_computeOutlineSlots()` ghosts that row; adding a card therefore re-centres every card and every outline. The fix (sibling item) will derive positions from `maxSlots`. These tests must be red against the current code and green once the fix lands.

The existing Phaser mock in `tests/ui/handView.outlines.test.ts` (mock `scene.add.rectangle` / `image` / `text`) is the harness to reuse; assert on `scene._rectangles` (outlines), `handView` sprites, and `outlineRects`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- Parent AC1: with `maxSlots` set, the set of outline slot positions for a given capacity is **identical** for a hand of 0, 1, … `maxSlots` cards (measured: the `outlineRects[i].x` for every `i` is unchanged across `setCards` of each size) — asserted as a unit test in `tests/ui/handView.outlines.test.ts`.
- Parent AC2: adding a card places it in the next empty slot to the right of the occupied run, and every already-placed card keeps its pre-add position (measured: for `addCard`, `sprite[i].x` before === after for all pre-existing `i`) — asserted for successive adds up to capacity and for successive `setCards` growth.
- Parent AC3: occupied outline slots still sit at the exact card position and rotation (`rect.x/y/rotation === sprite.x/y/rotation`), and extra capacity slots still render below every card — the CG-0MT6ER7YY003G680 invariant is preserved.
- Parent AC4: changing capacity (`setMaxSlots(n)`) re-lays the whole row and always yields exactly `n` slots; this is the only mutation that may move existing cards.
- Parent AC5: the empty-hand capacity row is unchanged from today's behaviour — `maxSlots` straight/arc slots centred on the hand centre — so an empty hand still shows the full capacity in the same place the cards will occupy.
- Parent AC6: unit tests verify AC 1–5, including a regression test that asserts positions do **not** move across successive `addCard`/`setCards` calls up to capacity, and that `setMaxSlots` does re-layout.
- Rotation/arc stability: per-card rotation and arc Y are derived from the capacity template, so they do not change when a card is added (assert `sprite.rotation` unchanged for pre-existing cards).
- `getInsertionPosition(i)` equals the rendered sprite position after inserting at `i` (guards the Main Street market→hand transfer).
- Over-capacity (transiently `cards.length > maxSlots`) is best-effort: the first `maxSlots` slots stay fixed, outlines stay capped at `maxSlots`, overflow cards continue to the right with the same step.
- Hands without `maxSlots` keep the existing centred-on-count layout (regression guard), and vertical cascade (already count-independent) is unchanged.
- Run via `npx vitest run --project unit tests/ui/handView.outlines.test.ts` (unit profile).

**Key Files:**

- `tests/ui/handView.outlines.test.ts` — extend with the stability/regression cases (existing Phaser mock harness).
- `src/ui/HandView.ts` — read-only reference for the API under test.

**Deliverables:**

- Failing-then-passing automated regression tests in the `unit` profile.

## Goal

Extend the Gym and Main Street browser suites to assert slot/card **position stability across a draw/add** (parent AC7), rather than only alignment at a single hand size.

## Context

Parent: CG-0MUAYBB4E007LWEQ. Test-first item.

Both suites currently capture positions once and assert outline↔card alignment. They never assert that adding a card leaves the pre-existing cards/outlines where they were, so the reported bug slips through. Gym: `GymHandPileScene` (`maxSlots: 7`, `[ Draw ]` button). Main Street: `MainStreetRendererStreet` (`maxSlots: state.maxHandSize`, `centerX: handCenterX`).

## Acceptance Criteria

- Parent AC7: browser tests (`tests/handView/gym-handpile-outlines.browser.test.ts`, `tests/main-street/hand-outlines.browser.test.ts`) assert slot/card position stability across a draw/add, not just alignment at a single hand size.
- Gym: capture card + outline `x/y/rotation` before `[ Draw ]`, emit the draw, then assert every pre-existing card and outline is unchanged (within `toBeCloseTo`) and the newly drawn card fills the next slot to the right.
- Main Street: add a card to the hand (market→hand path or `addCard`) and assert every pre-existing card and outline is unchanged; assert `getInsertionPosition(nextIndex)` equals the rendered sprite position.
- Main Street click/drag/transfer paths still hit the moved cards: the existing `hand-outlines` and market↔hand transfer assertions continue to pass after the layout change.
- Both files run green under `--project browser`, tolerating arc/rotation via `toBeCloseTo`.

**Key Files:**

- `tests/handView/gym-handpile-outlines.browser.test.ts` — add draw-stability case.
- `tests/main-street/hand-outlines.browser.test.ts` — add add-card stability + insertion-position case.
- `example-games/gym/scenes/GymHandPileScene.ts` — scene wiring reference (read-only).
- `example-games/main-street/scenes/MainStreetScene.ts` — `getBusinessHandInsertionPosition` / `getEventHandInsertionPosition` reference (read-only).

**Deliverables:**

- Browser regression tests proving stable slots across a draw/add.

data.description:
## Goal

Fix the shared `HandView` so that, when `maxSlots` is set, card and outline positions derive from the hand's **capacity** rather than the current card count — adding a card never moves an existing card or slot.

## Context

Parent: CG-0MUAYBB4E007LWEQ. Sibling test items add the failing unit and browser tests first.

Root cause: `computeCardPositions()` builds a row centred on `this.cards.length` (`layoutCardPositions({ count: this.cards.length, … })`), and `_computeOutlineSlots()` ghosts it (plus appending extras). The empty-hand branch already lays out the desired fixed `maxSlots` row, so that row is the template to reuse. `getInsertionPosition()`, `rebuildDisplay()`, `applyLayout()`, and the animated `sortCards` path all re-derive the row/rotation normalisation from the occupied positions and must move to the template as well. `setMaxSlots()` currently only rebuilds outlines and does not re-lay the cards.

## Acceptance Criteria

- Parent AC1–AC5: implement the capacity-template behaviour — outline slot positions identical for a hand of 0…`maxSlots` cards; `addCard` fills the next slot right of the occupied run while pre-existing card positions are unchanged; occupied outlines still match card `x/y/rotation` with extras below every card; `setMaxSlots(n)` is the only mutation that re-lays the row and always yields exactly `n` slots; the empty-hand capacity row is unchanged (same centred straight/arc row the cards will occupy).
- Add a shared private helper in `src/ui/HandView.ts` that derives the `maxSlots` template with the existing `layoutCardPositions` maths (gap = `spacing - cardWidth`, `centerX`, `maxWidth` compression, `arcRadius` Y) and the template-span rotation normalisation; recompute from current options on each use (no stale cache).
- `computeCardPositions()` horizontal returns the first `cards.length` template positions; over-capacity cards continue with the template step to the right (best-effort, no re-centring).
- `getInsertionPosition(index)` returns the template position at `index` (first `maxSlots`; template step beyond), so Market→hand transfer animations land exactly on the resting card.
- `_computeOutlineSlots()` derives all `count` slots from the same template (occupied slots ghost the card's **actual** sprite rotation, extras keep `depth = index - 0.5 - count`), replacing the per-count ghosting/extension branch.
- Rotation and arc normalisation in `rebuildDisplay()`, `applyLayout()`, and the animated `sortCards` path use the template span when `maxSlots` is set, so per-card rotation is also stable across adds.
- `setMaxSlots(maxSlots)` re-lays the cards (calls `applyLayout()`), not just the outlines.
- Capacity-driven layout is keyed on `maxSlots !== undefined`, independent of `showPositionOutlines`; toggling outlines never moves cards.
- Hands without `maxSlots` keep the existing centred-on-count layout; vertical cascade keeps `baseY + i * spacing` and is not regressed.
- `src/ui/layoutCardPositions.ts` is reused unchanged.
- The sibling unit and browser test items pass (`npx vitest run --project unit tests/ui/handView.outlines.test.ts`).

**Key Files:**

- `src/ui/HandView.ts` — `computeCardPositions()`, `_computeOutlineSlots()`, `getInsertionPosition()`, `rebuildDisplay()`, `applyLayout()`, `sortCards()` animated path, `setMaxSlots()`.
- `src/ui/layoutCardPositions.ts` — reused to build the capacity row (no change expected).

**Deliverables:**

- Capacity-driven `HandView` layout with stable card and outline slots and green sibling tests.

## Goal

Document the capacity-driven (stable) slot semantics and remove stale wording that describes the hand as centred on the **current** card count (parent AC8).

## Context

Parent: CG-0MUAYBB4E007LWEQ. The fix changes documented behaviour, so the doc-update policy applies: the change and its docs must ship together (or this child blocks parent closure).

## Acceptance Criteria

- Parent AC8: all related documentation is updated to reflect the changes, including code comments, `docs/DEVELOPER.md` (Hand capacity outlines), `AGENTS.md` if the documented behaviour changes, and any relevant Gym/docs entries.
- `docs/DEVELOPER.md` "Hand capacity outlines" states that when `maxSlots` is set the slot row is derived from **capacity**, cards fill it left-to-right, occupied card/slot positions do not move as cards are added, and `setMaxSlots()` is the only operation that re-lays the row; the empty-hand row is unchanged.
- `AGENTS.md` §2 (HandView/PileView key features) hand bullet updated to say slots/outlines are capacity-derived and stable across adds.
- `example-games/gym/scenes/GymHandPileScene.ts` help text describes the fixed-slot behaviour instead of implying per-count centring.
- Stale per-count-centring comments corrected in at least: `example-games/main-street/scenes/MainStreetTurnControllerMarketActions.ts` ("centred on handCenterX" / "left-anchored slot estimate"), `example-games/main-street/scenes/MainStreetRendererStreet.ts` ("centred on handCenterX"), and `example-games/main-street/scenes/MainStreetTutorialHints.ts` (hand-zone comment).
- No player- or developer-facing text still claims the hand is centred on the current card count when `maxSlots` is set.

**Key Files:**

- `docs/DEVELOPER.md` — "Hand capacity outlines" section.
- `./AGENTS.md` — §2 hand bullet (and §9 if it repeats the layout claim).
- `example-games/gym/scenes/GymHandPileScene.ts` — help text.
- `example-games/main-street/scenes/MainStreetTurnControllerMarketActions.ts` — stale comments.
- `example-games/main-street/scenes/MainStreetRendererStreet.ts` — stale comment.
- `example-games/main-street/scenes/MainStreetTutorialHints.ts` — hand-zone comment.

**Deliverables:**

## Planning Complete — CG-0MUAYBB4E007LWEQ

Decomposed "Card outlines and card positions move when a card is added to the hand" into a test-first, dependency-ordered feature set. Parent AC1–AC9 are collectively covered; no parent AC is dropped or re-scoped.

### Feature plan (test-first order)

| # | Child | Type | Depends on | Covers |
|---|-------|------|-----------|--------|
| 1 | Unit tests: capacity slots stay fixed (CG-0MUITAUFJ005SLIY) | task | — | AC1, AC2, AC3, AC4, AC5, AC6 |
| 2 | Browser tests: slot stability across add (CG-0MUITAVFM008GR5A) | task | — | AC7 |
| 3 | Capacity-driven HandView slot template (CG-0MUITAWAU0040XB8) | bug | 1, 2 | AC1–AC5 (fix) |
| 4 | Update docs and stale centring comments (CG-0MUITAX4O001Z8RF) | docs | 3 | AC8 |
| 5 | Full-suite verification and audit readiness (CG-0MUITAY7G007ILML) | task | 3, 4 | AC9 |

Each child carries the parent's measurable assertion verbatim (tagged `Parent AC n`) so coverage is auditable. The test items (1, 2) are created and sequenced **before** the implementation item (3), per the test-first requirement; the implementation is the single vertical slice (shared `HandView` change) that turns both red suites green, followed by docs and end-to-end verification.

### Key design points captured during planning

- The **empty-hand** `maxSlots` row already produced by `_computeOutlineSlots()` is the desired fixed template; reuse it for cards and outlines at every hand size.
- Three additional code paths re-derive the row/rotation from the occupied count and must move to the template: `getInsertionPosition()` (Market→hand transfer destination), `rebuildDisplay()`/`applyLayout()` rotation normalisation, and the animated `sortCards` path — otherwise cards stay put but **rotate** as neighbours are added.
- `setMaxSlots()` currently only rebuilds outlines; it must also re-lay the cards (AC4), since capacity change is the one permitted re-layout.
- Layout stays keyed on `maxSlots !== undefined`, not `showPositionOutlines`, so toggling outlines never moves cards.
- `src/ui/layoutCardPositions.ts` is reused unchanged.

### Automated review stages

Finished Requirements & AC alignment review: every parent AC (1–9) traces to exactly one child (AC1–6 → unit tests + implementation; AC7 → browser tests; AC8 → docs; AC9 → verification); no contradictory or invented criteria; the CG-0MT6ER7YY003G680 outline/depth invariant is preserved in AC3.

Finished Completeness review: all five children carry Goal, Context, Acceptance Criteria, `**Key Files:**` and Deliverables; `validate_key_files_format()` passes for every child (two initial issues — bare `AGENTS.md` and a non-path line under Key Files — were corrected before completion).

Finished Sequencing & dependencies review: unit → browser tests (no prerequisites) → implementation (depends on 1, 2) → docs (depends on 3) → full-suite verification (depends on 3, 4); test tasks precede implementation tasks; dependency edges added via `wl dep add`.

Finished Scope sizing review: each child is a deliverable increment (two focused test suites, one shared-component fix, one docs pass, one verification gate); no child mixes unrelated layers; the core fix is a single end-to-end slice.

Finished Acceptance & testability review: every AC is pass/fail and testable — position-equality assertions on `outlineRects`/`sprite` coordinates, `setMaxSlots` slot-count equality, `getInsertionPosition` equality, builder commands (`npm run build`, unit/smoke/dev/browser/full profiles), and doc/comment presence.

Finished Polish & handoff review: descriptions are actionable with copy-pasteable commands and real file paths; risks (Market Street `handCenterX` anchoring / transfer coordinates, `maxWidth` re-compression on capacity change, over-capacity transients) are carried into child 3 and child 5; the parent scope-creep guard (hands without `maxSlots` unchanged) is restated in child 3.

### AC coverage review

`run_coverage_review(CG-0MUAYBB4E007LWEQ)` → `recommendation: proceed`. Note: the shared extractor only parses `- ` bullets under `## Acceptance Criteria`, and this item's ACs are a numbered (`1.`) list, so it extracted zero parent ACs (coverage trivially 100%). Coverage was therefore verified manually: children 1–5 each restate the parent ACs they satisfy with an explicit `Parent AC n` marker, and all of AC1–AC9 map to exactly one child — no uncovered gap, no unresolvable conflict.

### Appendix: clarifying questions & answers (plan)

Context was gathered by inspecting the seed item plus `src/ui/HandView.ts` (`computeCardPositions`, `_computeOutlineSlots`, `getInsertionPosition`, `rebuildDisplay`, `applyLayout`, `sortCards`, `setMaxSlots`), `src/ui/layoutCardPositions.ts`, the three existing test files, and the Main Street / Gym wiring. The intake brief already answered the material questions, so no new operator interview round was required for this planning pass.

- Q (from intake): Which layout should a capacity hand use? — **Assumption (agent, carried forward):** the fixed centred capacity row already rendered for an empty hand, cards filling it left-to-right. The bug report's "positions should not move" requirement forces this: the only alternative (anchor slot 0 at the hand centre) would move the empty-hand outlines when the first card is drawn. **OPEN QUESTION (non-blocking, for producer):** confirm the user-visible consequence that a 1-card hand shows its card in the leftmost capacity slot (off-centre) rather than centred — this is the only existing-scene appearance change. Directed to the producer; it matters because it changes Main Street's 3-card and Gym's 7-slot hand look for a 1-card hand. It does **not** block planning or implementation — the requirement logically determines the layout — and can be confirmed at review/audit.
- Q (from intake): Does the fix apply to the shared `HandView` or Main Street only? — **Assumption (agent):** shared `HandView`, keyed on `maxSlots`, because both `MainStreetRendererStreet.ts` and `GymHandPileScene.ts` enable `maxSlots` + outlines and show the same defect.
- Q (from intake): Should toggling outlines on/off move cards? — **Assumption (agent):** no; layout is keyed on capacity, not outline visibility.
- Q (from intake): What happens when a slot is added? — **Assumption (agent):** the row re-lays out (`setMaxSlots`), the one case where movement is expected — now also enforced for card layout, not just outlines.

### Risks carried into implementation

- Main Street `handCenterX` anchoring and the hand→street/market→hand transfer coordinates (`hiddenTransferSourceCardIds`, `getInsertionPosition`) — mitigated by browser stability tests (child 2) and the Main Street browser suite in verification (child 5).
- `maxWidth` compression makes the step depend on `maxSlots`, so a capacity change can shift positions by more than one slot — accepted (capacity change is an allowed re-layout).
- Over-capacity transient states — best-effort behaviour specified and unit-tested (child 1).
- Rotation stability (not just X/Y) — explicitly covered so outlines that ghost card rotation don't shear when a card is added.

### Plan: changelog

- 2026-09-26 — `plan` skill (target: this item): pre-check returned `plan` (effort Small, risk Medium); approval gate returned `request_approval: false` (risk Medium does not trigger approval). Created 5 child work items (2 test-first, 1 implementation, 1 docs, 1 verification), added dependency edges, refreshed the effort/risk estimate (Small / Medium, expected 7.12h, recommended 10.12h, confidence 72%), and ran the six automated review stages plus the AC coverage review. No parent AC changed.
